questions.question: We _____ that museum last year.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي البسيط مع وقت ماضٍ محدد مثل last year.

questions.question: She has _____ her homework already.
questions.explanation_ar: يتكون المضارع التام من has أو have مع التصريف الثالث للفعل، وfinished هو التصريف الثالث من finish.

questions.question: Look! The children _____ in the garden.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع المستمر لحدث يحدث الآن، وكلمة Look تدل على ذلك.

questions.question: If it rains tomorrow, we _____ at home.
questions.explanation_ar: في الشرط الأول نستخدم المضارع البسيط بعد if، ثم will مع الفعل الأساسي في النتيجة.

questions.question: You _____ wear a helmet when riding a bicycle.
questions.explanation_ar: should تستخدم للنصيحة، وارتداء الخوذة نصيحة مهمة للسلامة.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: The letters is delivered every morning.
questions.correct_answer: The letters are delivered every morning.
questions.explanation_ar: الفاعل letters جمع، لذلك نستخدم are وليس is في المبني للمجهول.

questions.question: My father bought _____ umbrella yesterday.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم an قبل صوت حرف العلة، وكلمة umbrella تبدأ بصوت علة.

questions.question: There are _____ apples in the basket.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم many مع الأسماء المعدودة في صيغة الجمع مثل apples.

questions.question: I studied hard _____ I wanted to pass the exam.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم because لذكر السبب.

questions.question: Match each action with its correct meaning.

pairs.right: Take something to a person or place

questions.explanation_ar: اربط كل فعل بالمعنى المناسب له.

questions.question: Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.correct_answer: My brother has never visited London.
questions.explanation_ar: نرتب الجملة بالفاعل ثم has ثم never ثم التصريف الثالث للفعل visited ثم المكان.

questions.question: Which action helps reduce plastic waste?
questions.explanation_ar: استخدام الأكياس القابلة لإعادة الاستخدام يقلل الحاجة إلى الأكياس البلاستيكية.

questions.passage: Last month, students at Green School started a community project. They planted flowers and small trees near the school entrance. Some students watered the plants, while others collected rubbish. Their teacher explained that plants make the area more beautiful and help the environment. After three weeks, the entrance looked cleaner and greener.
questions.question: What did the students plant?
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أن الطلاب زرعوا الزهور والأشجار الصغيرة بالقرب من مدخل المدرسة.

questions.question: What did some students do while others collected rubbish?
questions.explanation_ar: يوضح النص أن بعض الطلاب كانوا يسقون النباتات بينما جمع الآخرون النفايات.

questions.question: How did the entrance look after three weeks?
questions.explanation_ar: في نهاية النص، أصبح مدخل المدرسة أنظف وأكثر خضرة.

questions.question: Why was the school community project useful?

rubric.sample_answer: It made the school entrance cleaner and more beautiful and helped the environment.

questions.explanation_ar: استنتج الفائدة من المعلومات الموجودة في النص، ولا تكتفِ بنسخ جملة واحدة.

questions.question: The path was slippery because of the rain. What does slippery mean?
questions.explanation_ar: كلمة slippery تعني زلقًا، أي يمكن أن ينزلق الشخص عليه بسهولة.

questions.question: While I _____ dinner, my brother called me.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي المستمر للحدث الذي كان جاريًا عندما وقع حدث آخر في الماضي.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: He don't like cold weather.
questions.explanation_ar: مع he نستخدم doesn't في النفي بالمضارع البسيط، ويأتي الفعل بعده بصيغته الأساسية.

questions.question: The opposite of "careful" is _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نضيف اللاحقة less إلى care لتكوين careless، وتعني غير حذر.

questions.question: Write three or four sentences about a school activity you enjoyed.

rubric.sample_answer: I enjoyed our school sports day. I played football with my friends. We worked as a team and had a great time.

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب عن نشاط مدرسي استمتعت به، واذكر ماذا فعلت ولماذا أعجبك.

questions.question: Write a short message to your friend inviting them to your birthday party. Include the day, time, and place.

rubric.sample_answer: Hi Ahmed, I am having a birthday party on Friday at 5 p.m. at my house. I hope you can come!

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب رسالة قصيرة تتضمن التحية والدعوة واليوم والوقت والمكان.

questions.question: If your friend finds a lost wallet at school, what should your friend do? Explain why.

criteria: Suggests giving the wallet to a teacher or responsible adult
Explains that the owner should get it back
rubric.sample_answer: My friend should give the wallet to a teacher. The teacher can help find the owner and return it.

questions.explanation_ar: فكر في التصرف الصحيح والأمين، واشرح سبب اختيارك باللغة الإنجليزية.

questions.question: Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.correct_answer: If we save water, we will help the environment.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه جملة شرطية من النوع الأول: المضارع البسيط في جملة if، وwill مع الفعل الأساسي في النتيجة.

questions.question: Imagine you are planning a school trip. Write five or six sentences explaining where you want to go, what you will take, what you will do there, and how students should stay safe.

criteria: Includes at least one safety rule
rubric.sample_answer: I want to visit a nature park with my classmates. We will take water, food, and notebooks. We will walk along the safe paths and learn about plants. We will take photos of the trees and birds. Everyone should stay with the group and follow the teacher's instructions.

questions.explanation_ar: هذا سؤال ختامي يجمع مهارات الكتابة والتخطيط والمفردات والقواعد والتفكير. اكتب إجابة مترابطة من خمس إلى ست جمل.
